verdict.rationale: Porkbun explicitly documents true bulk operations for transfers ("submit up to 500 domains at a time") and portfolio-wide auto-renewal settings, and its REST API/DNS CRUD endpoints can be scripted across many domains/records by an agent. However, there's no documented native bulk endpoint for DNS record updates, bulk registration, or bulk SSL retrieval — these would require looping per-domain API calls rather than a single bulk call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk DNS/record update endpoint, bulk registration/renewal API (beyond auto-renew toggle), and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows at scale.
